description: EN-0224 YMDDateCheckFilter control with valid weekday

files.rules.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="en">
<category id="CAT1" name="cat">
<rule id="R1" name="r"><pattern><token>Monday</token></pattern><filter class="org.languagetool.rules.en.YMDDateCheckFilter" args="date:2020-01-01 weekDay:\1"/><message>msg</message><example correction="">It is Monday.</example></rule>
</category>
</rules>
